description: Night photograph of the north facade of the White House with its exterior floodlights dark, only low ground-level lighting visible at the fountain hedge; a U.S. flag flies dimly atop the roof. Matches images circulated around May 31 - June 1, 2020, during the George Floyd protests, when the White House was shown with lights out. Photo credit watermark reads Christian Christensen.
flags: Date/context (May-June 2020 protest "lights out" imagery) inferred from circulation, not shown in the image

description: Screenshot from a Q-drop viewer app showing drop #14, titled 'Military Intelligence & State Secrets', posted by Anonymous on 31 Oct 2017. The drop embeds Emanuel Leutze's painting 'Washington Crossing the Delaware' and consists of a long series of rhetorical questions about military intelligence, POTUS, Flynn, HRC, Mueller, Soros and ANTIFA. A red box has been drawn around the opening lines 'SCI[F] / Military Intelligence.' to highlight them.
text: 14. Military Intelligence & State Secrets. Anonymous. 31 Oct 2017 - 10:00:15 PM. 1509505215390.jpg. SCI[F]. Military Intelligence. What is 'State Secrets' and how upheld in the SC? What must be completed to engage MI over other (3) letter agencies? What must occur to allow for civilian trials? Why is this relevant? What was Flynn's background? Why is this relevant? Why did Adm R (NSA) meet Trump privately w/o auth? Does POTUS know where the bodies are buried? Does POTUS have the goods on most bad actors? Was TRUMP asked to run for President? Why? By Who? Was HRC next in line? Was the election suppose to be rigged? Did good people prevent the rigging? Why did POTUS form a panel to investigate? Has POTUS *ever* made a statement that did not become proven as true/fact? What is POTUS in control of? What is the one organization left that isn't corrupt? Why does the military play such a vital role? Why is POTUS surrounded by highly respected generals? Who guards former Presidents? Why is that relevant? Who guards HRC? Why is ANTIFA allowed to operate? Why hasn't the MB been classified as a terrorist org? What happens if Soros funded operations get violent and engage in domestic terrorism? What happens if mayors/ police comms/chiefs do not enforce the law? What authority does POTUS have specifically over the Marines? Why is this important? What is Mueller's background? Military? Was Trump asked to run for President w/ assurances made to prevent tampering? How is POTUS always 5-steps ahead? Who is helping POTUS?
flags: The drop's questions are the poster's claims/insinuations, not established facts
'Adm R (NSA)' is understood in context as Adm. Michael Rogers, inferred rather than fully named
George Washington appears only as the subject of the embedded painting

description: Video-still photograph of President Donald Trump holding a black Bible aloft in his right hand, standing in front of St. John's Episcopal Church near Lafayette Square, Washington D.C., during his June 1, 2020 photo op after protesters were cleared from the area. Behind him is the church's letter board listing service info and clergy names, partially legible (including 'Rob Fisher', the church's rector).
text: SUNDAY S. ONLI. ALL ARE W. CLERG. THE RE. ROB FISHER. JANE MILL. WILLIAM.
flags: Location and date identified from the widely reported event, corroborated by the partially legible church sign; sign text is cut off at the frame edge
